summary: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching a press release dated May 15, 2026, announcing the nomination of Sandeep Singh for election to its board of directors at the upcoming Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 23, 2026. No financial terms, stakes, premiums, or transaction mechanics are discussed. This is a routine director nomination in connection with an ordinary AGM, not a special situation event. The filing is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, and no takeover, restructuring, or activist campaign is indicated. What to watch: none; this is a routine governance update.
